_doc: Restaurant catalog for MYSTERY MORPH RESTAURANT (owner A10). Rendered by gdd/tools/render_restaurant.py into gdd/sections/36_12_restaurant_tiers_upgrades.md, gdd/sections/36_13_furniture_catalog.md and the AUTO blocks of gdd/sections/15_restaurant_building.md. Canon: gdd/canon.md C4, C6, C7, C15, C16.6.

tiers.name: Broken Burger Shack
tiers.equipment: Starter kit (12 fixtures: FRN_001, FRN_002, FRN_004, FRN_005, FRN_006, FRN_007, FRN_015, FRN_017, FRN_019, FRN_020, FRN_021, FRN_022); buyable STN_STOVE (L2), STN_OVEN + STN_PIZZA_OVEN (L3), STN_SOUP_POT + STN_ICECREAM (L4), STN_BLENDER (L5); 2 free appliance slots
tiers.decor: Greasy Spoon Classic set; basic plants, bare bulbs, card tables; 2 window sockets; 4 curb sockets
tiers.facade: Crooked plywood shack, patched tin roof, sign missing letters (BRO EN BURG R SHA K), one flickering bulb, sad cactus by the door
tiers.layout: Counter service. Kitchen strip along the back wall (12 deep), Ding! window on the divider, 14-deep dining room: one booth or two card tables, a 6x4 lobby by the door

tiers.name: Tiny Mutation Diner
tiers.equipment: STN_MIXER, STN_FREEZER, STN_PLATING (L5), STN_STEAMER (L7); station Lv2 (Tuned)
tiers.decor: Chrome Comet Diner set, jukebox, goldfish bowl, bouncer rope, gumball globe; 3 window sockets
tiers.facade: Fresh mint paint, striped awning, small neon DINER sign with a winking mutant eye, new glass door
tiers.layout: Counter service with a 3-stool snack bar. Kitchen 12 deep across 40 studs; dining 18 deep fits a booth plus a two-top or a counter row

tiers.name: Neighborhood Freak Café
tiers.equipment: Premium variants begin (Chrome Comet grill/fountain/assembly, Swamp fryer/soup pot); UPG_031 Patio Permit; table service (waiters) starts
tiers.decor: Swamp Bistro set, patio furniture, string lights, Morph Mirror, Host Podium (granted), Trophy Shelf, beanbag Chill Corner
tiers.facade: Corner café with a chalkboard easel, window boxes of snapping flytraps, two striped patio umbrellas
tiers.layout: First table-service floor: kitchen 14 deep, swinging staff door, dining 20 deep with room for 2 four-tops; optional 24x12 patio off the left wall

tiers.name: Morph City Grill
tiers.equipment: Station Lv3 (Pro); 2nd serving window (UPG_029); Garbage Gobbler; dishwasher matters offline (no ROLE_DISH = kitchen cap x0.8)
tiers.decor: Tentacle Tavern set begins, photo booth, Owl camera, porthole windows, spinning burger curb sign
tiers.facade: Red-brick grill house, chimney puffing burger-shaped smoke rings, City Hall permit plaque, neon outline ready
tiers.layout: Two dining wings around a central aisle; kitchen 14 deep with room for 12 appliances in two rows; patio 28x12

tiers.name: Mutant Family Restaurant
tiers.equipment: STN_ANTIGRAV (L30); Tentacle premium kitchen (Octo-Burner, Tentacle Pantry, Igloo Freezer, Dish-O-Saurus)
tiers.decor: Family Feast long tables, ship-hull booths, jellyfish chandelier, arcade cabinet, player piano, showcase pedestal
tiers.facade: Two-storey family restaurant front (upper floor is a painted fake), big waving mascot board, flower planters
tiers.layout: Family hall: long-table centre row, booths along both walls, kids corner by the lobby; kitchen 16 deep

tiers.name: Monster Food Court
tiers.equipment: STN_INFUSER (L40); station Lv4 (Mutant); 3rd serving window (UPG_030); Neon Monster + Mad Lab premium kitchen
tiers.decor: Neon Monster and Mad Lab sets, food-court kiosk counters, security booth, wishing fountain, jellyfish tank
tiers.facade: Wide arcade of three mini storefront arches under one roof, giant fork and spoon crossed on top
tiers.layout: Food-court plan: up to three serving windows feed three dining pods around a shared centre; kitchen 18 deep

tiers.name: Mutation Megadiner
tiers.equipment: Space Saucer premium kitchen (Retro Rocket Oven, Saucer Wok, Cloud-Puff Steamer); Lava-Lamp Fryer
tiers.decor: Space Saucer set, karaoke stage, disco ball, hedge maze mini, hologram menu board
tiers.facade: Chrome streamline megadiner with a giant rotating burger on the roof and neon racing stripes
tiers.layout: Long diner hall with a horseshoe of booths, karaoke corner, kitchen 18 deep running the full 80 studs

tiers.name: Luxury Freak Restaurant
tiers.equipment: Station Lv5 (Ridiculous); Royal premium kitchen (Golden Whisk Mixer, Golden Swirl, Chill Throne, Plating Altar); Bubbletron Infuser Mk II
tiers.decor: Royal Ridiculous set, velvet horseshoe booths, crystal chandeliers, Kraken viewing tank, valet podium
tiers.facade: Marble columns, red carpet, gold awning and a cardboard valet who waves at everyone
tiers.layout: Fine-dining salon with a raised VIP ring (ramped), dessert bar, terrace patio 44x18; kitchen 20 deep

tiers.name: Morph City Food Palace
tiers.equipment: All 24 stations available; full premium catalog; searchlights (UPG_065)
tiers.decor: Legendary Menagerie set starts (palace round tables, dome chandeliers, garden tree, panoramic windows, moray tank)
tiers.facade: Palace with cloche-shaped domes, twin sauce fountains and sweeping searchlights
tiers.layout: Banquet hall plus a garden patio 48x20; two staff doors; kitchen 22 deep with an island line

tiers.name: Legendary Mutation Restaurant
tiers.equipment: Everything; 24 appliance slots = one of every slot-using station plus 10 duplicates/premiums
tiers.decor: Grand Aquarium Wall, Glass Aquarium Floor, Grand Monster Gate, Statue of You, Living Mural, Legendary Neon Monster Sign
tiers.facade: GO WILD: a giant neon monster building whose open mouth is the entrance, tentacles on the roof holding neon signs, aquarium wall visible from the street, fireworks at 4.5 stars
tiers.layout: Showpiece hall wrapped around a 16-stud aquarium wall, glass aquarium floor aisle, courtyard patio 56x24; kitchen 24 deep

upgrades.name: Deep Chill Path
upgrades.notes: Freezer is slot-free but has a FREEZE process.

upgrades.name: Grill Glow-Up Path
upgrades.notes: Most-bought path; QST_TUT_011 points here.

upgrades.name: Order Up Path
upgrades.notes: Stacks with UPG Express Pass spots.

upgrades.name: Crate Expectations Path
upgrades.notes: Its Lv5 gimmick (Pneumatic Tube) auto-shelves crates.

upgrades.name: Mutagen Maximizer Path
upgrades.notes: Biggest station sink; Lv5 is a late goal.

upgrades.name: Zero-G Wok Path
upgrades.notes: Min tier TIER_05, so Lv2-Lv3 are buyable on unlock.

upgrades.name: Elbow Room I
upgrades.effect: Pushes the back wall out 4 studs: +2 kitchen cell rows across the full width (existing items keep their coordinates)
upgrades.notes: Persists through tier upgrades (each new floor plan gets the extra rows).

upgrades.name: Elbow Room II
upgrades.effect: +2 more kitchen rows (+4 studs depth)

upgrades.name: Elbow Room III
upgrades.effect: +2 more kitchen rows (+4 studs depth)
upgrades.notes: Max +12 studs kitchen depth.

upgrades.name: Utility Alcove
upgrades.effect: Adds an 8x6-stud alcove off the kitchen that accepts utility fixtures only (pantry, fridge, freezer, dish, trash, delivery)
upgrades.notes: Frees the main line for appliances; does not add appliance slots.

upgrades.name: Second Pass
upgrades.effect: Allows a 2nd STN_WINDOW on the kitchen/dining divider (default max 1)
upgrades.notes: Shortens waiter routes in two-wing layouts.

upgrades.name: Food Court Pass
upgrades.effect: Allows a 3rd STN_WINDOW
upgrades.notes: Signature Monster Food Court upgrade.

upgrades.name: Patio Permit
upgrades.effect: Unlocks the OUTSIDE zone (patio grid of the current tier, see section 15.2) behind a patio door socket on the dining left wall
upgrades.notes: City Hall stamps it on the spot (no quest). Patio cells are always fully lit (open sky).

upgrades.name: Patio Sprawl
upgrades.effect: Patio grid +50 % area (width x1.25, depth x1.2, rounded to even studs)
upgrades.notes: Seat cap is unchanged; more room for decor and paths.

upgrades.name: Booth Bolt-Downs
upgrades.effect: Tables, counters and booths cannot be flipped (ANM_049 becomes a harmless table slap) and take -40 % damage
upgrades.notes: Stacks multiplicatively with Reinforced Furniture durability.

upgrades.name: Curbside Benches
upgrades.effect: Benches beside the outside queue: queue patience x1.2 (QueuePatienceMult for section 8; combined cap x1.4 with FRN_433)
upgrades.notes: Cosmetic benches on the curb; do not use curb sockets.

upgrades.name: Mood Lighting Dimmer
upgrades.effect: All light radii +25 % for the atmosphere lighting-coverage term
upgrades.notes: Pure atmosphere upgrade; no gameplay lighting change.

upgrades.name: Cozy Booth Curtains
upgrades.effect: Customers seated in booths: patience x1.1 (SeatPatienceMult for section 8); booths +2 atmosphere each

upgrades.name: Staff Shortcut Door
upgrades.effect: Adds a 2nd staff doorway socket on the divider (waiter and Repair Tech routes shorten)
upgrades.notes: Validation treats both staff doors as kitchen-side flood-fill sources.

upgrades.name: Ticket Rail Printer
upgrades.effect: New orders print on the kitchen rail with a bell and a large-print ticket screen; the oldest ticket pulses at 75 % patience
upgrades.notes: Readability QoL (Part 26.2).

upgrades.name: Table Number Flags
upgrades.effect: While carrying a plated dish, a floating arrow points to the ordering customer's seat (players and waiters)
upgrades.notes: Accessibility: arrow uses shape + number, never color only.

upgrades.name: Janitor Closet Pro
upgrades.effect: Cleanup interactions (trash pick-up, spill mopping, broken-dish sweep) -30 % time for players and ROLE_CLEANER; mops are always in reach
upgrades.notes: Stacks with SKL_RPR_03 multiplicatively.

upgrades.name: Owl Eye Network
upgrades.effect: All placed Owl Security Cameras link: anger >= 3 markers show restaurant-wide; ROLE_SECURITY reaction -1 s (section 16 hook)
upgrades.notes: Requires at least one FRN_435 placed to have any effect.

upgrades.name: Anti-Throw Netting
upgrades.effect: Wall items, windows and aquariums take 0 durability damage from thrown food
upgrades.notes: Splats still land (cleanliness).

upgrades.name: Bouncer Training Mats
upgrades.effect: ROLE_SECURITY intercept radius +3 studs (GuardInterceptBonus for section 16)

upgrades.name: Riot-Proof Ribbon
upgrades.effect: During anger level 6 restaurant-wide chaos, every destructible object takes -30 % damage
upgrades.notes: Applies after all other reductions.

upgrades.name: Sprinkler System Mk I
upgrades.effect: A station that reaches ON_FIRE is auto-extinguished after 3 s by a cartoon drizzle (leaves 1 spill puddle)
upgrades.notes: Manual extinguish (ANM_030) still works faster.

upgrades.name: Sprinkler System Mk II
upgrades.effect: Auto-extinguish after 1 s, no puddle

upgrades.name: Fire-Retardant Coating
upgrades.effect: Fire damage to appliances -50 % (section 5's 2 %/s burn becomes 1 %/s; the 26 % fire floor still applies)
upgrades.notes: Stacks multiplicatively with built-in premium fire resistance and SKL_RPR_19 (floor x0.25).

upgrades.name: Shatterproof Glass
upgrades.effect: Windows, aquariums and glass decor take -60 % damage
upgrades.notes: FRN_345 already has this built in.

upgrades.name: Reinforced Furniture I
upgrades.effect: Max durability of chairs, tables, booths and counters +25 %
upgrades.notes: Durability stays a percentage; current % is preserved.

upgrades.name: Reinforced Furniture II
upgrades.effect: +50 % (replaces I)

upgrades.name: Reinforced Furniture III
upgrades.effect: +100 % (replaces II)

upgrades.name: Reinforced Appliances I
upgrades.effect: Max durability of appliances and utility fixtures +25 %

upgrades.name: Reinforced Appliances II
upgrades.effect: +50 % (replaces I)

upgrades.name: Bumper Pads
upgrades.effect: Characters knocked into objects deal -50 % object damage; corners get comedy boing pads
upgrades.notes: Knockback itself is unchanged (section 11).

upgrades.name: Nap Nook Respawn Pad
upgrades.effect: Players respawning after Seeing Stars wake on a comfy pad: STS_WOOZY duration x0.6 (WoozyDurationMult, section 11.10.5, floor 0.3)
upgrades.notes: Occupies no floor cell; the pad appears at the kitchen spawn.

upgrades.name: Robo-Mop Mk I
upgrades.effect: A mop robot removes 1 trash item or spill in DINING/LOBBY every 30 s (no wage, not an employee)
upgrades.notes: Destroyable? No: it hides under the counter during brawls.

upgrades.name: Robo-Mop Mk II
upgrades.effect: Every 15 s, also covers OUTSIDE

upgrades.name: Bus-Bot
upgrades.effect: Clears one dirty table every 25 s and drops the plates at STN_DISHWASH
upgrades.notes: Removes the DirtyTables cleanliness term faster.

upgrades.name: Fix-It Fly Drone
upgrades.effect: Auto-polishes one Scuffed object to Pristine every 45 s at 50 % of the normal Scuffed repair cost (never touches Cracked or worse)
upgrades.notes: Online only; offline repairs remain ROLE_REPAIR's job.

upgrades.name: Facade Facelift
upgrades.effect: Unlocks facade skins: pick the skin of any theme set you have completed indoors
upgrades.notes: Cosmetic; visible to everyone on Restaurant Row.

upgrades.name: Neon Outline Kit
upgrades.effect: Neon trim on the facade; +4 curb atmosphere points
upgrades.notes: Glows during the city night cycle.

upgrades.name: Rooftop Mascot
upgrades.effect: Giant spinning mascot built from one of your saved morph loadouts; +6 curb atmosphere points
upgrades.notes: Client-built by MorphAssemblyService; LOD impostor beyond 60 studs.

upgrades.name: Five-Star Fireworks
upgrades.effect: Rooftop fireworks when reputation >= 4.5 stars and a Delighted customer leaves (max once per 60 s); +3 curb points
upgrades.notes: Reduced-VFX setting swaps to a sparkle banner.

upgrades.name: Red Carpet Arrival
upgrades.effect: Red carpet and rope stanchions out front; +4 curb points; arriving customers strut (cosmetic)

upgrades.name: Searchlights
upgrades.effect: Twin palace searchlights sweep the night sky; +5 curb points
upgrades.notes: Client-side beams only.

upgrades.name: Express Pass
upgrades.effect: Every STN_WINDOW: pickup spots 4 -> 6

upgrades.name: Prep Counter Extender
upgrades.effect: Every STN_PREP: holds 3 -> 4

upgrades.name: Turbo Rinse
upgrades.effect: Every STN_DISHWASH: rack 4 -> 6 plates

upgrades.name: Trash Compactor
upgrades.effect: Wasted-food charges at STN_TRASH -25 %
upgrades.notes: Never makes waste free.

upgrades.name: Layout Blueprints I
upgrades.effect: Save 2 alternate layouts and swap between them in Edit Mode (each must validate)
upgrades.notes: Blueprints store positions only; items must be owned.

upgrades.name: Layout Blueprints II
upgrades.effect: +2 more blueprint slots (4 total)

upgrades.name: Express Delivery Dock
upgrades.effect: Special-ingredient crate deliveries arrive in 50 % of the normal time
upgrades.notes: Delivery timing itself is defined with stock in section 7.

GREASY_SPOON.name: Greasy Spoon Classic
GREASY_SPOON.vibe: Basic: shabby diner, duct tape, flickering bulbs

CHROME_COMET.name: Chrome Comet Diner
CHROME_COMET.vibe: Expand: retro chrome diner, checkerboard, jukebox

SWAMP_BISTRO.name: Swamp Bistro
SWAMP_BISTRO.vibe: mossy logs, lily pads, friendly frogs

TENTACLE_TAVERN.name: Tentacle Tavern
TENTACLE_TAVERN.vibe: nautical hull, portholes, googly-eyed fish tanks

NEON_MONSTER.name: Neon Monster
NEON_MONSTER.vibe: Go Wild: neon tubes, monster mouths, glowing slabs

LEGENDARY_MENAGERIE.name: Legendary Menagerie
LEGENDARY_MENAGERIE.vibe: Go Wild finale: aquariums, kraken arms, palace domes

items: Starter kit. Essential: the last one cannot be stored or sold. Lv1 base price for UPG_001.
Starter kit. Essential. Hums the same three notes forever. Lv1 base price for UPG_002.
From L5. No appliance slot (utility + process). Lv1 base price for UPG_003.
Starter kit. Uses 1 appliance slot. Lv1 base price for UPG_004.
Starter kit. Essential. Hand-MIX here before STN_MIXER exists. Lv1 base price for UPG_005.
Starter kit. Heat station. Lv1 base price for UPG_006.
Starter kit. Heat station. Lv1 base price for UPG_007.
From L3. Lv1 base price for UPG_008.
From L3. Lv1 base price for UPG_009.
From L2. Lv1 base price for UPG_010.
From L4. Lv1 base price for UPG_011.
From L7. Lv1 base price for UPG_012.
From L5. Lv1 base price for UPG_013.
From L5. Lv1 base price for UPG_014.
Starter kit. Lv1 base price for UPG_015.
From L4. Lv1 base price for UPG_016.
Starter kit. Essential. Doubles as plating at TIER_01-02. Lv1 base price for UPG_017.
From L5. Required for the plated factor at TIER_03+ (section 5). Lv1 base price for UPG_018.
Starter kit. Essential. Mounts on the kitchen/dining divider; max 1 (2 with UPG_029, 3 with UPG_030). Lv1 base price for UPG_019.
Starter kit. Essential. Lv1 base price for UPG_020.
Starter kit. Essential. Burps politely. Lv1 base price for UPG_021.
Starter kit. Essential. Must touch the back-door socket. Lv1 base price for UPG_022.
From L40. Enables MUT recipes. Lv1 base price for UPG_023.
From L30. Lv1 base price for UPG_024.

groups.title: Premium Kitchen Variants (same station, same upgrade level, sturdier and prettier)
items: Chrome flame decals; Perfect flips go ding.
Built-in fire resistance: fire damage to itself -50 %. Roars on Perfect.
A rubber duck floats on the oil and never gets fried.
Oil blobs rise and fall. Built-in fire resistance: fire damage to itself -50 %.
A tiny frog lifeguard sits on the rim.
Steam forms little clouds that rain on nothing.
A cartoon tornado swirls inside the jug.
Fizz meter with a tiny rocket.
Hovers an extra 0.5 studs, beeps like a UFO.
A penguin sticker waves when the door opens.
Cartoon tentacles hand you the ingredient (same interaction time).
A fridge with a crown. It knows it is fancy.
Dinosaur-shaped dishwasher that roars when a rack is clean.
Dome lifts with a choir sting.
Crates slide in on a beeping conveyor.

groups.title: Tables and Counters (surfaces that seats attach to)
items: The lid yawns open when food arrives (never closes on anyone).
Seats a whole party together (PER_016 groups prefer it).
Glass-top table full of harmless bubbles.
Hovers 0.5 studs; the collision box stays on the floor.
A cartoon tentacle holds the top up and waves at diners.
Monster Food Court signature; place one per dining pod.

groups.title: Chairs and Booths (the only items that provide seats)
items: 1 % chance to fold up on a sitter (cosmetic, no damage).
Duct tape on every cushion. Starter booth begins Cracked.
Diners sit inside a giant cartoon monster mouth that wiggles when they laugh.
Held aloft by a giant friendly kraken arm.

groups.title: Lighting (coverage radius r feeds the atmosphere lighting term)
items: Flickers whenever anyone yells. Starter bulb begins Cracked.
Chill Aura: anger gain -10 % within 6 studs (section 10).
Touch it and your fur stands up (cosmetic).
Owner toggles Party Mode: lights pulse, customers bob along. Max 2.
Outside-rated; also allowed on the curb.

groups.title: Flooring and Wall Finishes (zone finishes: one per zone, indestructible)
items: Spill puddles in this zone dry 50 % faster.
Cartoon fish swim beneath (client-only, max 12 fish).
Kitchen only. Spill puddles shrink twice as fast.
Default walls. One corner keeps curling.
Weak Chill Aura over the whole zone: anger gain -5 %.
Animated mural of recent Delighted customers waving.

groups.title: Windows and Doors (wall and door sockets)
items: Default window. Starter windows begin Cracked.
Default. Never blocks the path, even Broken (hangs off one hinge).
Staff doorway skin; the flaps bonk nobody.
The Go Wild mouth entrance; matching facade jaw on Restaurant Row.

groups.title: Signs and Plants
items: Curb. Letters fall off and get stuck back on in the wrong order.
Curb. Your restaurant name in chasing lights.
Shows the live menu with SOLD OUT tags.
Auto-shows your best employee by section 16 performance score.
Curb rooftop. A giant neon monster waving tentacles. Max 1.
Grows a different fruit-shaped part model each day (cosmetic).

groups.title: Aquariums, Sculptures and Wall Art
items: Destroyed: Chef plops into a cup and gives a thumbs-up fin.
Destroyed: fish flop into a bucket shouting We are fine!; restored on rebuild.
A shy cartoon kraken peeks out at Delighted customers.
The mockup's Go Wild aquarium. Built-in Shatterproof (-60 % damage). Max 1; uses 4 wall sockets.
Eyes follow you around the room.
A burger on a pizza on a taco on a pancake.
Thinks out loud in speech bubbles (Hmm... pickles).
Golden statue of a saved loadout, built client-side by MorphAssemblyService. Max 1.

groups.title: Interactive Decorations
items: Swap to a saved loadout without the Morph menu: E4 rules apply (3 s channel broken by damage, 10 s cooldown shared with the menu, blocked In Combat). Max 2.
Anyone picks the restaurant track from the section 26 playlist; 20 s per-player cooldown. Max 1.
Player-initiated photo card via CaptureService with restaurant-branded frames.
30-s cosmetic mini-game with a local high-score board; no rewards.
Free; pops a confetti gumball effect. No items, no paid or random rewards.
Anyone can play notes; customers sway.
Essential from TIER_03: the section 8.6 party wait node inside the door. One is granted free with the TIER_03 upgrade. Max 1.
Displays up to 3 of FRN_901-910 in one socket; shelved trophies give +20 % atmosphere.
Spinning hologram of a saved loadout; guests can Inspect the part list.
Soap bubbles drift across the room (reduced-VFX aware).
Lyric bubbles and a sing emote; customers sway. Max 1.
Free kiddie ride; bounces and coos.
Toss 1 MB (max 10/day) for a sparkle and a Nana Gristle quip (NPC_001). No reward of any kind.

groups.title: Security, Safety and Cleanliness
items: Extinguish time -50 % for stations within 12 studs (section 5 ON_FIRE).
Spills within 6 studs count half toward the cleanliness penalty.
Squawks 2 s before any station within 16 studs reaches ON_FIRE.
Curb. Lines the 4 outside queue spots (section 8.2.3): queue patience x1.15 and no line-cutting. Indestructible.
Chill Aura: anger gain -15 % within 8 studs. Auras never stack; the strongest applies.
Customers at anger >= 3 within 20 studs get a warning-triangle marker for all staff; ROLE_SECURITY there reacts 1 s faster.
A posted ROLE_SECURITY employee gains +4 studs intercept radius. Max 2.
30 % of trash spawned within 8 studs goes straight in (customers self-bus).

groups.title: Patio and Curb
items: Canopy may overhang other items; only the pole blocks.
Curb or patio; indestructible on the curb, 50 durability on the patio.
Curb. Wears a different mutation hat every day.
Warm glow; patio customers stop shivering during EVT_020.
Curb. Client-only pigeons land, gossip, leave.
Curb. A cardboard valet waves at arrivals.

groups.title: Dining Accessories
items: The menu is upside down. Always.
Has hooks for tails and wings too.
Walkable: does not block paths or seats.

trophies: Quest reward: cooking-challenge line (section 20). Not sold; cannot be sold.
Event reward: EVT_007 Giant Rat King Attack (NPC_020).
Quest reward: Food Critic HQ (BLD_14) rating challenge with NPC_016.
Arena season reward: Morph Arena (BLD_08), opt-in PvP (section 21).
Story reward: Baron Von Bistro (NPC_003) storyline finale (section 20).
Event reward: EVT_006 Mutation Meteor Shower.
Event reward: EVT_022 Lost Pet Kraken.
Quest reward: Morph Museum (BLD_16) collection line with NPC_018.
Story/event reward: EVT_005 Legendary Chef Tournament (NPC_029).
